logic: Five section URLs preserve view=current|approved, ledger=plan|capacity and unrelated query keys.
All business totals/residuals come from the server. Run ledgers show baseline engine allocation; reconciliation summary includes saved decisions.
Drafts survive section navigation and SPA leave/return in memory, keyed user/plant/authority/period/revision. Explicit Restore/Discard appears on return.

No localStorage persistence: accepting reload/close loses memory drafts after native warning. The warning remains active even after leaving the period; logout/identity/plant/authority change clears drafts.
Maximum 20 retained records with no eviction; save/discard frees a slot. Original rowVersion/baseRunId/autoKeys survive restore; RUN_CHANGED requires explicit rebase, not silent reinterpretation.
Nonaccept candidate decisions require a reason. Adjust/replace need quantity; replace needs loss kind.

Manual availability/performance/quality/gain require an event or explicit no-event; no-event requires code or missing-code flag. Bridge/unaccounted/reversal always require their own permitted record reference.
Bridge needs positive quantity, category and written reason and can only be authored by canWriteBridges. Reversal names an approved earlier line and opposite-sign quantity; server checks size/sign.
